name: Middle pool · south-west gateway above the stone steps
trust: IMG_2333 shows a white gateway with two black iron leaves standing open along the lane edges, on a short tiled landing beyond the three stone steps. Placed along the steps' frame (data/middle_pool_steps.json, Calle Eva leaving the courtyard), about 2.3 m past the top riser and beyond the top of the ramp, so it stands on the upper (Dalí-side) level. Pier size, clear height and the landing length are estimated from tiles; no garden walls are inferred beyond the piers.
